title: loadng discovery: unified RREP verdict consults cache only — cache LRU(32)<gradient(64) so eviction reopens stale-install divergence
description: discovery.py:178-207 decides for both stores via cache.lookup(); when cache entry evicted but gradient holds fresher seq, stale/equal-seq RREP installs into cache while gradient.update rejects. Contradicts invariant at :171-177; reopens uosr class. Fix: fall back to gradient.lookup as authority or evaluate each store predicate and write only if both accept.
